problem_statement: FoodMart is a static Bootstrap grocery/ecommerce storefront (themewagon/FoodMart) with a hero banner carousel, a Category carousel, Trending Products tabs, product feeds, a blog strip, an app-download band and a footer, all served directly with no build step. Directly beneath the hero the storefront carries a 'Shop the aisle' product filter: a row of category tabs (All aisles, Produce, Bakery, Dairy), a live 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' readout, and a grid of six fresh product cards. The same 'Shop the aisle' filter is meant to appear on the storefront's two secondary shopping pages (deals.html 'Today's deals' and pantry.html 'Pantry essentials') so shoppers can filter from any landing page, and clicking a category tab must narrow the grid AND update the readout to the count and label of the aisle now on view. Three things are wrong in the current build and must all be repaired inside the existing static HTML/CSS/JS: (1) on a 390px phone the filter tab row is pinned to a fixed 720px nowrap width so it cannot reflow and the page overflows horizontally; (2) the filter only reaches the home page — the deals and pantry pages omit the 'Shop the aisle' filter entirely; (3) the desktop product grid collapses the six cards into an overlapping, illegible dark-on-dark pile instead of a tidy, readable grid. Repair the responsive tab-row reflow, restore the filter on both secondary pages, keep the product grid a clean legible grid, and keep the category-tab click wiring live (the readout must reflect the shown cards) — without changing the hero, the catalog carousels, the local imagery, or the footer.
required_content: The 'Shop the aisle' filter must keep its four category tabs (All aisles, Produce, Bakery, Dairy), its live 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' readout, and its six product cards.

On a 390px mobile viewport neither the home page nor the deals/pantry pages may overflow horizontally: the category tab row must reflow (wrap) instead of forcing a fixed-width row wider than the screen.
The 'Shop the aisle' filter must be present on the home page AND on both secondary shopping pages (deals.html and pantry.html), not the home page alone.
The desktop product grid must render the six cards as a clean, legible, non-overlapping grid — not a collapsed, overlapping, dark-on-dark pile.

Clicking a category tab (e.g. Produce) must narrow the grid to that aisle and update the readout to the matching count and label (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 6 · Produce'); the readout must not stay frozen at the initial 'Showing 6 of 6 · All aisles'.
Do not add dependencies, remote APIs, remote images, generated output files, backend code, or a replacement layout framework; fix it inside the existing static CSS/JS.
design_constraints: Treat the work as a focused continuity + responsive + interaction fix inside the existing static HTML/CSS/JS architecture, not a redesign or a new section.
Use the existing FoodMart visual language (fresh-green accents on a pale surface, the theme's rounded cards and typography) already used by the filter.
Keep the hero banner carousel, Category carousel, product feeds, and footer intact on every page.
The category tab row must degrade cleanly on 390px mobile without horizontal page overflow.
Keep the 'Shop the aisle' filter driven by the existing js/aisle.js handler; the readout must recompute on every tab click.
state_constraints: desktop_home / mobile_home / tablet_home verify the original home shell, hero carousel, local imagery, navigation and footer still render, and that the home page does not overflow horizontally at desktop/tablet width.
desktop_aisle verifies the 'Shop the aisle' filter renders beneath the hero as a clean, legible, non-overlapping product grid with the category tabs and readout at desktop width.
mobile_aisle and mobile_home verify the category tab row reflows so the home page does not overflow horizontally on a 390px phone.

desktop_deals and desktop_pantry verify the 'Shop the aisle' filter is present on BOTH secondary shopping pages (cross-page continuity), and mobile_deals verifies the deals page also does not overflow on mobile.
desktop_aisle_produce verifies that clicking the Produce tab narrows the grid and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Produce' (the interaction must not leave the readout frozen).

change_completion: The 'Shop the aisle' filter keeps all four category tabs, its live readout, and its six product cards.
The category tab click updates the readout to the count and label of the aisle on view.
design_consistency: The filter reuses the FoodMart fresh-green accent, pale surface and rounded card styling.
The filter is present on the home page and on both secondary shopping pages with the same styling.
The hero carousel, Category carousel, product feeds and footer keep their original hierarchy; no remote assets, framework replacement or unrelated section is introduced.
responsive: Desktop, tablet and mobile states capture without new horizontal overflow beyond tolerance.
The category tab row wraps on 390px mobile on both the home and the deals pages.
regression: The desktop product grid stays a clean, legible, non-overlapping grid rather than collapsing into an overlapping dark-on-dark pile.
Hero, Category, product feeds, footer, local imagery and the filter interaction remain present and working on every page.
No dependencies, build tooling, backend files, generated artifacts or remote APIs are added.

author_notes: L4 experience-continuity task on the themewagon/FoodMart static grocery storefront, built around a genre-native commerce lever: a 'Shop the aisle' product-category filter (tabs + live count readout over six real product cards) mounted beneath the hero and echoed on two secondary shopping pages, deals.html and pantry.html. Four orthogonal defects gate the four checks: a fixed-width nowrap category tab row overflows a 390px phone (no_horizontal_overflow); the filter is missing from the secondary pages (cross-page dom_assertions); the desktop product grid collapses into an overlapping illegible dark-on-dark pile (visual_regression on the aisle region — a genuine geometry break, not a recolor); and the category-tab click leaves the readout frozen at 'Showing 6 of 6 · All aisles' (interaction_assertions). The reference repairs all four inside css/aisle.js and css/aisle.css plus the secondary-page markup; the leg-varying files are css/aisle.css (layout), js/aisle.js (readout wiring) and the per-page filter presence. Local imagery (images/product-thumb, images/logo.png) and the FoodMart persona are preserved across all legs, and every state captures with zero console errors.
